definitions.explanation: A group within a larger organization that shares common interests or follows a particular leader. Most commonly associated with political factions within Japanese political parties.

examples.japanese: {派閥|はばつ}⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{派閥|はばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Factions have formed within the company.

examples.japanese: {派閥|はばつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力学|りきがく}→力学：25450_rikigaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Factional dynamics influenced the outcome of the party leadership election.

notes:
USAGE:
Strongly associated with Japanese politics, particularly the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), where factions have historically played a central role in leadership selection and policy direction. Also used in corporate and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {派閥|はばつ}⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ (factional politics)
- {派閥|はばつ}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ (factional strife)
- {派閥|はばつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{領袖|りょうしゅう} (faction leader)
- {派閥|はばつ}⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧ (dissolution of factions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{党派|とうは}→党派：23147_touha⟧: political faction or party — more formal
- ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧: group — more neutral, less political
